_comment: Lines the villagers fall back to when the dialogue model is unreachable. One source of truth: tools/build_world.gd puts them on each ConversationGroup, and tools/bake_voice_bank.gd synthesizes them into the committed voice bank. They are the lines a build with no API key relies on, so they are the ones most worth having permanently.

square: smith: Irons cost what they cost, Maud.
baker: And you'll have it, and a loaf besides.
tavern: innkeeper: You'll want the ledger straight before he comes.
guard: I want a good deal of things, Corwin.
innkeeper: Then have a drink while you want them.
chapel: elder: You needn't have come down the hill for this.
healer: I came for the air, Father.
elder: You came because you cannot leave it alone. Nor can I.
